key_insight: Fed-GRPO brings federated learning to GRPO by using reward statistics themselves to coordinate training without sharing raw data.
engineering_relevance: It enables privacy-preserving collaborative reasoning fine-tuning for LLMs while sharply reducing communication cost through reward-driven aggregation and sparse updates.
method: Signal-weighted aggregation: weight clients by reward standard deviation.
Global reward calibration: adjust local objectives using local-global reward gaps.
Adaptive sparse communication: allocate bandwidth to the most informative client updates.
evidence_signal: On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, Fed-GRPO outperforms other federated methods, beats FedAvg, approaches centralized training, and achieves up to 32× communication reduction and 621× compression with only graceful accuracy loss.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and stability of reward signals, so noisy or highly imbalanced client rewards could affect aggregation and calibration.
paper_title: Fed-GRPO: Reward-Signal-Driven Federated Group Relative Policy Optimization
